title: Offline learner pocket
objective: Cache public source-linked listings and minimal action status locally without caching authenticated API traffic.
guardrails: Service worker does not cache /api/**. IndexedDB stores public catalogue and action statuses, not profile/documents/income. Browser eviction and local access risks remain.
exitCriteria: After one online visit, public listings and locally saved actions remain visible offline
prototypeBoundary: This phase uses the Phase 09–17 prototype contracts. Database persistence and production auth are not claimed.
